name: Le cabinet du docteur
camera: at the west end of the consulting room, facing east (the waiting-room door is in the south wall = right)

setting.walls: pale duck-egg green-blue painted walls with white panelled dado
setting.landmark: a buttoned leather examination couch under a tall sash window showing a chestnut tree, with a folding cotton screen beside it
setting.light: clear morning light from the tall window
setting.style: S07 gentle storybook painterly 3.5/5 (one style for the whole Quartier de la Santé)

items.scene: A young angler hops on one foot holding his sore toe, a big shiny fish-shaped LURE ("doo-LUHR") dangling from his rod: what PAIN!
A polar bear with a FEVER ("FYEHVR") sits in a tub of ice cubes, a big thermometer in his mouth.
An old sailor shows the doctor a pale SCAR on his forearm, while his pots of drooping SICK TREES ("see-kah-TREES") wait beside him.
A boy pours PURE water from a glass jug over the tiny CUT on his finger: "COO, that's cold!" ("koo-PEWR"), a plaster ready on the table.
The DOCTOR, a kind woman with a stethoscope, listens to a teddy's heart while her cat PURRS ("TURRR") on the stool.
A mountain goat on top of the tall step-ladder clutches it with VERTIGO ("vehr-TEEZH"), eyes spinning in spirals.
Dr CAL ("may-dee-KAHL") opens his MEDICAL bag and finds a hamster asleep among the rolled bandages.

prompt:
Gentle storybook painterly illustration, realism about 3.5/5, soft gouache-and-oil brushwork, warm-hearted and calm, natural NEUTRAL daylight with true colours, off-white whites, no orange, sepia, amber or golden cast, no pink or blue tint, clear readable figures with contact shadows on the floor, consistent eye-level perspective, 16:9 wide composition.
Scene: Le cabinet du docteur in the B17_cabinet building, ground floor (east). Camera: at the west end of the consulting room, facing east (the waiting-room door is in the south wall = right).
Setting: pale duck-egg green-blue painted walls with white panelled dado; floor: black-and-white checkerboard tiles. Landmark: a buttoned leather examination couch under a tall sash window showing a chestnut tree, with a folding cotton screen beside it. Light: clear morning light from the tall window. The room feels lived-in and real, with depth (never an empty white backdrop).
Paint these exits clearly as walkable openings: the white panelled door on the RIGHT wall, ajar onto the sage-green waiting room (way to La salle d'attente); the doctor's big oak desk with green lamp in the BACK RIGHT corner (a small spot to look at closer).
Characters and objects, each a separate, clearly spaced group, feminine-word groups on the left half and masculine-word groups on the right half:
- far left, foreground: A young angler hops on one foot holding his sore toe, a big shiny fishing LURE dangling from his boot lace: what PAIN!
- far left, middle distance: A polar bear with a FEVER sits in a tub of ice cubes, a big thermometer in his mouth.
- left, foreground: An old sailor shows the doctor a pale SCAR on his forearm, while his pot of two drooping SICK TREES waits beside him.
- centre-left, middle distance: A dove COOS on a boy's shoulder as he holds out a finger with a tiny CUT under a jug of PURE water, a plaster ready.
- centre-right, foreground: The DOCTOR, a kind woman with a stethoscope, listens to a teddy's heart while her cat PURRS on the stool.
- right, middle distance: A mountain goat on top of the tall step-ladder clutches it with VERTIGO, eyes spinning in spirals.
- right, foreground: Dr CAL opens his MEDICAL bag and finds a hamster asleep among the rolled bandages.
Leave a blank light board for the room sign high on the back wall. No written words, letters, numbers or logos anywhere (signs and plaques are blank boards). No blood, no wounds, no needles in skin (syringes only as capped harmless props), no alcohol, no smoking, no religious symbols, no red-cross emblem. Nobody cropped by the image edge; keep every figure well inside the frame with a clear gap between figures. Figures stand on the floor or sit on real furniture, never floating or in rows behind a counter.
